title: 第811章 周光寒彻
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

东胜神洲，鎏瓶沙。

白玄灵藏匿自身气息，目光扫过面前在一片黄沙之中平静无波的一汪形状如同瓶子的湖水。

根据楚星尘给的舆图判断，大部分的灵脉支流都流向了此处，而且还有其他支流也在挪动，根据预测，最终的目的地应该也是在这里。

更改灵脉，哪怕只是支流本身就是一件极难的事情，这并非是靠蛮力就能做到。

哪怕是十八仙门也只是在主流灵脉流转之处建立宗门，而不是能扭曲灵脉流转，因此也有不少仙门建宗位置便差的离谱，都是后来慢慢花了大力气调整过来。

就按照如今的天衍宗能力，要想调整灵脉支流走向，也不是不能，而是要花费极其大的代价，而且也不可能像这群天魔一般仿佛那么轻易的就能扭转支流。

恐怕其中用到了权柄的手段。

当年天道一度崩散，权柄坠落，除了天魔之外，十八仙门也都分别获得一些，只不过当年大部分都被天下第一宗的玄清天宗整合收敛。

相比天魔肆意污染测试权柄的威能。

玄清天宗的做法一直是想尽办法归还这些天道权柄，各家也是亲眼看见玄清天宗归还权柄的动作。

所以历年来十八仙门各家名义上并未过多研究权柄威能。

毕竟当年天道崩散，很大程度上也是为了挽救这方生灵，归还权柄一事就是绝对正义以及不容置疑。

尤其有人把天道丢失权柄和无法飞升挂上联系。

其中缘由也能自圆其说，所以能持权柄的渡劫修士，总有万一的可能，也会为了能够成仙选择交出权柄。

但无论如何，当年天道崩散的权柄都有一部分落到了天魔的手中。

例如许玲珑曾经展露过难以置信的幻术或许便是权柄的威能。

如今这些灵脉挪动，大概率也该是权柄的能力。

白玄灵目光扫过下方，也仔细感受着下方的灵力波动，但却没有发现任何异常。

在这汪湖水里吗？

白玄灵微微迟疑，但却并没有真的深入湖水之中探明情况。

毕竟这要真是天魔的最终大阵，用脚指头想都知道里面必然做了重重的准备。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Dongsheng Shenzhou, gilded vase of sand.

Bai Xuanling hid his aura and glanced at the calm, waveless lake in front of him that was shaped like a bottle in a patch of yellow sand.

Judging from the map given by Chu Xingchen, most of the spiritual tributaries flow here, and there are other tributaries that are also moving. According to predictions, the final destination should be here.

Changing a spiritual vein, even if it is just a tributary, is an extremely difficult task. It cannot be done by brute force.

Even the Eighteen Immortal Sects only established sects where the mainstream spiritual veins circulated, rather than distorting the flow of spiritual veins. Therefore, there were many Immortal Sects that established sects in ridiculously poor locations, but they later spent great efforts to adjust them.

According to the current capabilities of the Tianyan Sect, it is not impossible to adjust the direction of the tributaries of the spiritual veins, but it will cost an extremely high price, and it is impossible to reverse the tributaries as easily as these demons.

I'm afraid that some means of authority were used.

At that time, the way of heaven collapsed and authority fell. In addition to the heavenly demons, the eighteen immortal sects also gained some, but most of them were integrated and consolidated by the Xuanqing Tianzong, the number one sect in the world.

Compared with the power of the demon's wanton pollution test authority.

Xuanqing Tianzong's approach has always been to try every means to return these heavenly powers, and each family has also seen with their own eyes Xuanqing Tianzong's actions to return their powers.

Therefore, over the years, each of the Eighteen Immortal Sects has not done much research on authority and power.

After all, when the law of heaven collapsed, it was largely to save this living being. The return of power is absolute justice and cannot be doubted.

In particular, some people link the loss of power of Heavenly Dao to the inability to ascend.

The reason can be explained by itself, so there is always a possibility that the Tribulation Monk who can hold authority will choose to hand over his authority in order to become an immortal.

But no matter what, part of the power when the law of heaven collapsed fell into the hands of the demon.

For example, Xu Linglong once showed incredible illusions that may be the power of authority.

Now that these spiritual veins are moving, it is most likely due to the power of authority.

Bai Xuanling glanced below and carefully felt the spiritual power fluctuations below, but did not find anything abnormal.

In this lake?

Bai Xuanling hesitated slightly, but did not really go deep into the lake to investigate the situation.

After all, if this is really the final formation of the demon, you can tell with your toes that heavy preparations must have been made.
